{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black fine-knit crew-neck sweater, fitted, hip-length, black (#1C1C1E), merino wool blend
Dark straight-leg jeans, high-rise, ankle length, deep indigo (#2B3045), stretch denim with a matte finish
Black leather ankle boots, low block heel, closed round toe, black (#171717), smooth leather
Black wool-blend biker-style jacket, tailored, cropped at the hip, black (#202020), textured wool with a matte finish
Slim leather belt, thin, black (#1A1A1A), smooth leather
Small crossbody bag, compact, worn across the body, black (#181818), grained leather
Small silver hoop earrings, thin, silver (#C0C0C0), polished metal

This outfit works because the dark, classic palette keeps the look restrained while still fitting the spirit of a rock concert. The fitted knit and straight jeans stay neat and comfortable for standing in a crowd, and the low block heel gives stable footing for hours. The cropped textured jacket adds the right autumn warmth and an edge without becoming costume-like, and the club's artificial light will bring out the depth of the black and indigo. A crossbody bag keeps her hands free and her belongings secure in the crush."}
